about.eyebrow: A kitchen with a point of view
about.title: Closer to the source.
about.intro: Maison Ember is a place to slow down, eat well, and feel at home in the heart of Bangkok.
about.imageAlt: The Maison Ember team preparing dinner in the open kitchen
about.heading: Good cooking begins long before the flame.
about.paragraph1: It begins in the soil, with people who know their land. We work with small growers and fishers across Thailand, taking what is ready and letting it shape our menu.
about.paragraph2: Then we bring it close to the fire. Wood and charcoal lend their own quiet character, drawing out the sweetness, the smoke, the edges worth sharing.
about.paragraph3: We believe hospitality is a kind of attention: remembering what matters, making space at the table, and never rushing the last glass.
about.value1Copy: Menus follow the market, with Thai produce at the heart of every plate.
about.value2Copy: Wood and charcoal bring out the honest character of each ingredient.
about.value3Copy: Unhurried, generous hospitality. There’s always room for one more.
